title: To rename the Stop Trading on Congressional Knowledge Act of 2012 in honor of Representative Louise McIntosh Slaughter.
official_summary: (Sec. 1) This bill changes the title of the Stop Trading on Congressional Knowledge Act of 2012 to the "Representative Louise McIntosh Slaughter Stop Trading on Congressional Knowledge Act."

summary.headline: This law renames the 2012 congressional stock trading ban act in honor of former Representative Louise McIntosh Slaughter.
summary.what_it_does: The law changes the official title of the Stop Trading on Congressional Knowledge Act of 2012. The new title is the Representative Louise McIntosh Slaughter Stop Trading on Congressional Knowledge Act. It does not change any of the act's rules about trading or disclosure.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: It took effect when it was signed into law on November 3, 2018.
